rule: EU 212 api.md §New vectors 1 · a supplier's reply → yes | no | unclear. Normalised: NFD, accents and Greek tonos stripped, lower case, apostrophes deleted (as AP6 1.0.1) and split (1.1), punctuation to spaces. Order: no letters (emoji, '?') → unclear · a question → unclear · phrases matched longest first and consumed (so 'no problem' is a yes and its 'no' is gone) · yes AND no → unclear · no → no · yes with a condition word → unclear (a condition is not a yes) · yes → yes · nothing → unclear. Emoji never decide. Unclear goes to the operator; AgAPI never guesses.
